purpose: Portable evidence for a reproduced Core bus/police lane standstill. Passing opening-delivery and paid Line 1 checks remain separate from the needs-review traffic result. This historical candidate does not replace the current 5ae4 loading choice.

inspection.method: 89 completed ordinary held-button steps from a fresh boot, read-only memory/OAM observations and a genuine in-game A+B+Select+Start reset. No memory writes, injected progression, restored emulator checkpoint, browser or physical-device action.
inspection.labelMeaning: Retained labels describe inspection intent. Raw bytes and authenticated addresses determine actual fields. Labels mentioning legs do not establish native leg IDs.
inspection.pngCountMeaning: 104 step sample references point to 81 distinct PNG byte hashes. The closed local archive has 125 PNG files including additional archive sampling; the portable steps do not enumerate every archive image.
inspection.pngHashVerification: Every referenced archived PNG exists and its file SHA-256 matches the retained sample hash. RGBA hashes are retained tool metadata, not recomputed in this audit.

scope: Opening Market Start completes at frame 572 with condition 100, 116 seconds left, base 86 + time 23 = credit 109, cash 139 and one completion. The genuine result PNG and raw state agree.
Ordinary parking and walking reach Union. Scheduled Line 1 Union to Wellesley costs 3 once, cash 139 to 136; frame 2646 shows RIDE with three seconds left.

Paid MAP frames 2706 to 2946 freeze all 58 gameplay bytes for 240 frames. Explicit save, four-button reset and normal HELP dismissal preserve the paid ride, cash 136, one completion and the original Core car at 754.25/720. Subsecond changes 55 to 2 and the safe pose changes; reset does not preserve all 58 bytes identically.
Actual Wellesley arrival is frame 3766 at 640/176 without a second fare. Ordinary walking reaches the bus observation sidewalk at 840/147 by frame 4260.

Actual bus 696/176 and police 712/184 remain unchanged at frames 5580, 6180, 6340 and 6524. The 5580 to 6180 interval is 600 neutral frames; other fleet coordinates and pedestrian phases advance. Raw state gives world seconds 80 at 6180 and 86 at 6524.
The recording reviewer reports world seconds 70 to 86 across the standstill. Starting second 70 is reported in the stop reason, not raw-decoded from a C1F6 snapshot at frame 5580.
Route 19 remains selected in pedestrian slot 2 with no stun or lag; native phases 5, 125, 77, 13 and 5 at frames 4260, 4860, 5260, 5580 and 6180 show walking continuing.
Tool-reported OAM peaks are 4 at frame 4260 and 6 at 6340, with zero scanlines exceeding 10. At 6340 only one partially clipped bus object is returned, not a full bus pose OAM sample.
A lane correction requires a new matching ROM and ordinary-input replay; this record does not verify the later proposed correction.

recording.reason: Delivery, paid train, map freeze, paid reset and ordinary arrival/access pass in this recording. The reproducible Core bus/police standstill requires review and correction.

limitations: Historical cf2f needs-review recording. Loading remains the separately tested 5ae4 Queen street-life candidate; no loading guide or release changes here.
Relative archive locators and hashes are not public downloadable gameplay or save files. No PNG binary, SRAM file, activation state or host path is included.
Leg IDs and headings are not authenticated by adjacent cache bytes. Opposing motion/body calculations are source/pose analysis, separate from actual native positions.
Starting world second 70 is a recording-review report; raw gameplay snapshots authenticate later seconds 80, 83 and 86.

Sampled OAM limits do not prove all-city sprite safety or CPU pacing. This record does not establish the later lane correction, all 96 contracts, remaining Island missions, two measured enjoyable hours, browser restart, legacy save imports or physical cartridge execution.
